s: Din ketibat hattepillin ubo p' seipim: mitzvat tepillin — sheyyiktob arba parashiyyot shehuzkeru bahen mitzvatan, shehen: "qaddesh li kol bekor" ad "lemoadah miyyamim yamima", "vehaya ki yebiaka" ad "ki bechozeq yad hotzianu Hashem mimmitzrayim", uparashat "shema" ad "ubishareka", uparashat "vehaya im shamoa" ad "al haaretz". Vetzarik lekotban kasseder shehen ketubot battora, liktob techilla parashat "qaddesh", veachar-kak "vehaya ki yebiaka", veachar-kak "shema", veachar-kak "vehaya im shamoa". Veim shinna sidran — pesulin (hattepillin hannaasim mipparashiyyot ellu. Abal happarashiyyot atzman yesh lahen taqqana, shehammuqdemet battora shekketabah baacharona — hare yakol liktob od parashiyyot hamucharot lah uletzorpan eleha, veken hamucharot shekketaban barishona — yakol letzorpan leparasha muqdemet, mittepillin acherot shennipselu bahen parashiyyot hamucharot. Veim i epshar lo letzorpan — tzerikim geniza). Veyesh omerim sherauy lehaqdim gam ken parashiyyot shel yad leshel rosh, mippene shemmuqdemet bappasuq. Ak im lo hiqdim — lo pasul. (Veyesh omerim shellekattechilla rauy lehaqdim parashiyyot shel rosh leshel yad, mippene sheqqedushshat shel rosh chamura mishshel yad. Veken nakon al pi haqqabbala):
Al pi haqqabbala tzarik liktob d' shel "echad" gedola kol-kak kemo arbaa daleti"n qetannim:

Lekattechilla tzarik liktob arba parashiyyot shel yad biqlap echad, shenneemar: "vehaya leka leot", mashma ot achat, dehaynu bayit echad, shehu ot hannireh mibbachutz, ukeshem shehi ot achat mibbachutz — kak yesh lihyot ot achat mibbipnim, shettihyena kol happarashiyyot keiggeret achat al qelap echad. Abal bitpillin shel rosh, sheyyesh bo arbaa battim — tzarik shettihyena happarashiyyot ketubot bearbaa qelapim lekattechilla, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Halaka lemosheh missinay sheen hattepillin niktabin ella bidyo. Veyesh mi shehora sheen hasseta"m niktabin ella bidyo sheyyukal lehimmacheq, kemo shekkatub beparashat sota: "vekatab … umacha" — ketab sheyyukal limchot, ulemedin gezera shava "ketiba" "ketiba" mipparashat sota lista"m, lepikak en metilin qanqantom letok haddeyo, mippene sherishshumo nikkar meod veeno nimchaq legamre. Vetob lachosh lidbarayv lekattechilla, laasot haddeyo meashan etzim o shemanim sheruyim beme apatzim vekayyotze bahem, sheim timmachaqna yehe nimchaq. Vekol haashanim yapim lidyo, veshel shemen zayit min hammubchar. Veim katab seta"m beme apatzim veqanqantom shehu omed veeno nimchaq — kesherim, shehaiqqar sheen lemedin "ketiba" "ketiba" mipparashat sota, veken nohagin akshav apillu lekattechilla. Im ken mah miata halaka shenneemra lemosheh missinay sheyyihyu kotebim bidyo, lemaet shear mine tzibonim, kegon haadom vehayyaroq vekayyotze bahem, sheim katab bista"m apillu ot achat bishar mine tzibonim o bezahab — hare ellu pesulim, utzerikim geniza, ella kol hakketab tzarik sheyyihyeh shachor. Veim zaraq aprot zahab al haotiyyot — maabir hazzahab veyishshaer ketab hattachton vekasher. Abal im zaraq et hazzahab al ot achat mehaazkara en lo taqqana utzerika geniza, lepi sheasur lehaabir hazzahab, mippene shehu kemocheq et hashshem:

"Uketabtam " — dareshu chakamim sheyyehe ketab tam veshalem, shello tidbaq ot achat bachabertah, ella kol ot tehe muqqepet gevil mikkol ruchoteha, utehe metuyyeget kehilkatah, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman lv. Veim haot gedola venidbeqa besopah beopen sheim yigror mah sheddabuq yishshaer tzurat ot — yesh mi shemmakshir ap belo gerira. Veyesh lehachamir veligror. Vaapillu im en haot debuqa beatzmah ella hattag shel ot zo dabuq betag ot acheret — yesh lehachamir uletaqqen bigrira. Vaapillu im tage ot achat debuqim zeh bazeh — tob letaqqenam, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman lv. Vetiqqun moil ap bitpillin umezuzot, ap bingiot ot beot beinyan shennipselu ledibre hakkol kemo sheyyitbaer:
Lekattechilla yiktob ketiba gassa qetzat, shello yihyu nimchaqim mehera. Veken mitzva leyappotan mibbachutz lemareh, vekol shekken mibbipnim, shehare bet hammiqdash haya metzuppeh zahab mibbipnim:

Yesh omerim shetztzarik liktob beyamin, veim katab bismol — pasul, lepi sheen derek ketiba bekak, uketiba kilachar yad hi, shehare hakkoteb beshabbat beyad semol — patur, veen sebara sheyyiktob adam seta"m beshabbat veyippater. Vaapillu im sholet bishne yadayv — tzarik liktob lekattechilla beyamin, veim katab bismol — kasher. Veitter yiktob beyamin shello shehi semol shel kol adam, veim katab bismolo shehu yamin shel kol adam — pasul. Umikkol maqom, im i epshar limtzo tepillin acherim shenniktebu beyamin — yesh lehakshir hanniktabim bismol, ben beitter ben bismol shel kol adam, meachar shello huzkar pesul zeh battalmud. Abal katab bepiv, shettapas haqqulemus bispatayv vekatab bo — pesulim apillu i epshar limtzo acherim, shebbevadday en derek ketiba kelal bappeh:

Hattepillin enan kimzuza, shehi tzerika sirtut mehalaka lemosheh missinay bekol shita veshita, abal bitpillin en tzarik sirtut, ki im bashshita haelyona, mippene sheasur middibre soperim liktob lekattechilla shalosh tebot mippasuq mikkitbe haqqodesh belo sirtut, kemo shekkatub beyoreh dea siman rapad [saip b], abal shear hashshitot en tzarik sirtut, ki hashshita haelyona naaset kemo sirtut lemah shettachteha , kemo sheyyitbaer sham. Veen lo lehachamir ulesartet bekol hashshitot, mippene shekkol happatur min haddabar veosehu — niqra hedyot. Abal im eno yodea leyashsher hashshita belo sirtut — tob hu sheyyesartet kol hashshurot, kede sheyyihyeh hakketab meyushshar veshaveh, mishshum "zeh eli veanvehu". Vaapillu im yodea leyashsher ap belo sirtut (ayyen bet yosep), umesartet kede liktob yoter naeh veyoter yashar — eno niqra hedyot, kevan sheeno oseh bederek chumra, ella kede liktob yoter beyosher (shehu hiddur mitzva). Velo ameru shekkol happatur min haddabar ku', ella kesheoseh bederek chumra (bemaqom shello yabo lide issur im lo yinhog bechumra zo, vegam en bah mishshum hiddur mitzva, abal im yesh bah ezeh hiddur leezeh mitzva, veken im hu noheg bah lisyag vegader shello yabo lide issur — eno niqra hedyot. Vezehu taam kol hachumrot shehechemiru haacharonim shehen achat mishtayim, o lisyag vegader shello yabou laabor al ezeh lo taaseh apillu issur qal shel dibre soperim kesherau shetztzarik lekak, o mishshum hiddur leezo mitzvat aseh apillu shel dibre soperim. Abal bemaqom shello shayyak hiddur, kegon hayyosheb bassukka bishat haggeshamim — hare zeh hedyot, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman taralat, veken kol kayyotze bazeh). Velo yesartet beoperet vekayyotze bo, mippene shemmeqom hassirtut nishar tzabua, ubediabad kasher. Veyesh omerim shetztzarik lesartet tamid lemala ulematta umin hatztzedadim, ben bitpillin, ben bekol maqom shekkoteb shalosh tebot mippasuq, veap al pi sheyyodea liktob belo sirtut. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea sham, veap-al-pi-ken nohagin lehachamir bitpillin kassebara haacharona:

Halaka lemosheh missinay sheen tepillin niktabot ella al haqqelap, velo al haddukesusetus velo al haggevil, veim shinna — pasul. Veen kotebin al haqqelap ella bimqom basar, veim katab bimqom sear — pasul. Mahu qelap? Umahu dukesusetus? Haor bishat ibbudo, shehu niqra gevil, hayu choleqin oto lishnayim, vehacheleq hachitzon shehu letzad hassear — niqra qelap, shenniqlap mecheleq happenimi haddabuq labbasar, hanniqra "dukesusetus", ki "duk" hu maqom belashon arammi, ve"susetus" hu basar bilshon yavan. Umah sheameru shekkotebin al haqqelap bimqom basar, hu bemaqom hayyoter qarob labbasar, dehaynu bimqom chibburo keshehu dabuq laddukesusetus. Ugevilim shellanu sheen choleqim otam — yesh lahem din qelap, vekotebin alehem tepillin batztzad shekkelappe habbasar, ki mah shemmegorerim mehaor qelippato haelyona shebbimqom sear, eno ella kede mah shetztzarik letaqqeno ulehachaliqo, vaapillu im hayu choleqin oto lishnayim — haya tzarik ligror mimmennu kol-kak, umitztzad habbasar gorerin mimmennu harbeh ad sheen nishar ella haqqelap bilbad:

Haqqelap tzarik lihyot meor hamubbad baapatzim o besid vekayyotze bo middebarim hamkavvetzim et haor umachaziqin oto, sheim lo ken — hare hu niqra diptera, veeno niqra seper belashon ibri, upasul liktob alayv seper tora, shenniqra "seper" bekamma meqomot battora, vehu haddin liktob alayv tepillin o mezuzot (shennilmadim bigzera shava "ketiba" "ketiba" misseper tora, shebbimzuza neemar "ketiba" beperush, utepillin huqqeshu limzuza, shenneemar: "uqeshartam…uketabtam", shemmippene zeh tzarik gam beseper tora utepillin ketiba tamma, mimmah shenneemar bimzuza "uketabtam", ulemedin hemenna litpillin beheqqesh, uleseper tora bigzera shava). Vetzarik lizzaher sheyyehe haor munnach besid ad sheyyippol hassear mealayv meelayv, veim motzio qodem laken — lo yiktob alayv, mippene shello nitabbed kol tzorko vediptera hu:

Vetzarik sheyyehe meubbad lishmo, kegon beseper tora — leshem seper tora, ubitpillin — leshem tepillin, ubimzuza — leshem mezuza. Vehamubbad leshem seper tora — kasher gam litpillin umezuza, shehare qedushshat seper tora chamura miqqedushshat tepillin umezuza, vahare zeh keillu nitabbed gam litpillin umezuza, sheyyesh biklal matayim maneh. Abal hamubbad leshem mezuza — pasul litpillin, ki qedushshat hattepillin gedola miqqedushshat hammezuza. Vetob sheyyotzi bispatayv leshem seper tora o leshem tepillin, velo day bemachashaba:

Im ibbedo nokri — yesh poselin, apillu yisrael omed al gabbayv veomer lo sheyyeabbed lishmo, kemo shehagget shekketabo nokri — pasul, ap al pi sheyyisrael omed al gabbayv veomer lo sheyyiktebennu lishmo velishmah, lepi shehannokri ledaat atzmo hu oseh veeno shomea lehayyisrael (veap al pi shehu omer sheshshomea lo — en piv velibbo shavin, veap im omer shekkepiv kak libbo — en neeman al kak). Veyesh makshirin kesheyyisrael omed al gabbayv veomer lo sheyyeabbedennu lishmo, veeno domeh leget, shetztzarik liktob kol torep hagget lishmo velishmah, vezeh lo yishma lo, abal beibbud en tzarik raq keshennoten haor letok hassid sheyyittenennu lishmo, vezeh yishma lo. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tzarik lesayyeo qetzat beibbudah. Veken nohagim bimdinot ellu, sheen abbedanim yisreelim metzuyim bekol hammeqomot. Vetzarik lesayyeo baibbud atzmo, abal en moil mah shemmesayyeo lehashchir haretzuot, sheen zeh mimmeleket haibbud. Ubediabad apillu lo siyyeo kelal, raq sheamar lo sheyyitten letok hassid lishmo — kasher. Veim hayyisrael noteno betok hassid lishmo — manniach et hannokri bilbaddo lehotzio letaqqeno, veeno tzarik lesayyeo od:

Orot shennotenin lannokri leabbedan lishman, umesammen otam binqabim sheoseh bahen bemartzea keen otiyyot, shello yachalipem hannokri beorot acherim — ap al pi shennaqel lannokri lezayyep, sheyyanniach or zeh al gabbe or acheret vinaqqebem bemartzea derek hanneqabim sheasa hayyisrael — en chosheshin lekak, mippene shemmityare hannokri pen yakkir hayyisrael bitbiut ayin shennatan besimanim, o mippene sheellu hanneqabim naasu yoter mechadash mishshello. Or sheibbedo shello lishmo, im yesh tiqqun lachazor uleabbedo lishmo — yitbaer beyoreh dea siman raa:

Tzarik sheyyihyeh haqqelap meor behema o chayya o op hattehorim, vaapillu minnebelot uterepot shellahen. Abal lo meor behema chayya veop hattemein, shenneemar: "lemaan tihyeh torat Hashem bepika" — min hammuttar bepika. Velo meor haddag apillu hu tahor, mippene shezzuhamato rabba. Veken kol azkara apillu shello bista"m — en kotebin oto al gabbe or behema temea vekayyotze bah:

Hassoperim hazzerizim osim shelosha mine qelapim: haab yoter liktob bo parashat "shema" shehi qetanna, vehaddaq mimmennu leparashat "vehaya ki yebiaka" shehi yoter gedola, uleparashat "qaddesh" uleparashat "vehaya im shamoa" shehen arukkot — osim qelap daq meod, ubazeh yitmalleu habbattim beshaveh, vezehu noy tepillin:

Kebar nitbaer shetztzarik lihyot ketiba tamma ushelema, lepikak tzarik shello yihyeh baqqelap shum neqeb bemaqom sheyiktob. Veim katab bimqom neqeb pasul, mippene sheenah ketiba tamma ushelema ella mupseqet. Vaapillu im en hanneqeb mapsiq kol obi haot meeber el eber, ella hu beemtza haobi, udeyo maqqipo mikkol tzad — mikkol maqom beoto meqom hanneqeb hi mupseqet vachaluqa lishtayim. Vaapillu im yesh beobyah shemmishshene tzidede hanneqeb keshiur obi hatztzarik leot zo, vaapillu im gam yesh beorek haot ad hanneqeb keshiur orek hatztzarik leot zo — mikkol maqom kevan sheanu choshebim hanneqeb lepissuq begup haot, im ken en sham heqqep gevil leorek haot shead hanneqeb, veken laobi shebbetzidede hanneqeb — en sham heqqep gevil bimqom hanneqeb, vehaot tzerika lihyot kullah muqqepet gevil mikkol ruchoteha, shello yihyeh mashshehu mimmenna belo heqqep gevil, vehaggevil shebbesiyyum haobi shemmitztzad zeh shel hanneqeb eno moil lehaobi shemmitztzad zeh, mippene shehanneqeb mapsiq benehem vecholeqam lishnayim, veken haggevil shebbesiyyum orek haot shelleachar hanneqeb eno moil leorek haot shead hanneqeb. (Umikkol maqom im yakol ligror min obi shemmitztzidede hanneqeb, sheyyishshaer qelap chalaq mapsiq ben hanneqeb loobi haot shebbetziddo, veken im yakol ligror meorek shellemala mehanneqeb veap-al-pi-ken yishshaer keshiur orek hatztzarik leot zo — hare gerira zo moelet apillu im kebar katab harbeh achar ot zo, veen bazeh mishshum shello kesidran, kevan sheen pesul beot zo, ella mishshum heqqep gevil, kemo sheyyitbaer):

Vekol zeh (beneqeb hannaasa qodem hakketiba), keshechalal hanneqeb nireh laayin, shenniret haot chaluqa lishtayim bimqom hanneqeb, abal kol neqeb shehaddeyo ober alayv vesotemo veeno nireh ella neged hashshemesh — eno neqeb kelal, vekotebin alayv lekattechilla. Umippene zeh hittiru liktob al or op hamubbad, ap al pi shekkullo male neqabim daqqim mimmeqom hannotzot:

Vekol zeh beneqeb hannaasa qodem hakketiba, shebbishat hakketiba kebar hi mupseqet al yede hanneqeb veenah tamma ushelema. Abal im hayeta ketiba tamma kehilkatah veachar-kak era bah neqeb, ap al pi shehanneqeb mapsiq kol obi haot meeber leeber veniret chaluqa lishtayim, im yesh beorkah shead hanneqeb keshiur heksher ot zo beli tzerup mah shemmehanneqeb ulematta — keshera. Veap im en kashshiur ad hanneqeb, ella shehanneqeb eno mapsiq kol obi haot, ella nishar meobyah chut daq shalem betzad hanneqeb — keshera, shehare im asa obyah daq kol-kak mittechillatah — hayeta keshera, shehare lo natenu shiur loobi haotiyyot, veyakol laasotan daq kemo sheyyirtzeh:

Vekamma hu shiur heksher orek haotiyyot shennipsequ beneqeb? Im nipseqa regel haymanit shel he"a vekayyotze bah, kegon hare"sh o haddale"t, venishtayyer mimmenna lemala mehanneqeb kimlo ot qetanna shehi yu"d — keshera. Abal im nipsaq haregel hassemalit shel he"a, yesh omerim sheapillu lo nishtayyer mimmenna ella kol shehu ben lemala mehanneqeb ben lematta mehanneqeb — keshera. Veyesh omerim sheggam regel hassemalit tzarik lihyot kimlo yu"d, veim lav — pesula. Veken halaka. Abal im niqqab tokah shel he"a o shel me"m vekayyotze bahen, apillu hanneqeb memalle kol hechalal velo nishar sham heqqep gevil — keshera. Veken im en heqqep gevil kelal leezo ot mibbachutz shenniqqab sham neqeb arok hammaggia ad sop haqqelap — keshera, kevan shehayeta muqqepet qelap mittechillatah bishat hakketiba. Abal im lo hayeta muqqepet qelap mittechillatah, ap al pi shehi arukka karauy velo nipseqa kelal beneqeb, kegon regel ka"p o nu"n happeshutot vekayyotze bahen shebbashshita haacharona shehen arukkot umaggiot ad sop haqqelap, mittechillatan — pesulot. [U]mikkol maqom im yakol ligror mehen meat besop haqqelap veyishtayyer bahen keshiur — hare gerira zo moelet apillu achar ketibat kol happarasha, veen bazeh mishshum shello kesidran, kevan shello hayu pesulot techilla, raq mishshum chesron heqqep gevil bilbad kemo sheyyitbaer. Veyesh omerim sheim hanneqeb memalle kol chalal hahe"a o hamme"m vekayyotze bahen — pesulot, kevan sheenan muqqapot gevil betokan, veap al pi shehayu muqqapot mittechillatan. Abal im en hanneqeb memalle kol hechalal, ap al pi shehanneqeb hu samuk laot mammash, shello nishar qelap chalaq apillu mashshehu ben haot lehanneqeb shebbetokah, vehaot tzerika lihyot kullah muqqepet gevil mikkol ruchoteha — mikkol maqom hi chashuba muqqepet gevil gam bimqom hanneqeb, al yede qelap hechalaq shebbetokah mitztzad hashsheni shel hanneqeb. Veken im hanneqeb hu bemiqtzat obi haot shekkelappe chutz, umiqtzat obyah shekkelappe tokah nishar qayyam — hare hi keshera al yede miqtzat obi zeh shekkelappe tokah, shehu chashub muqqap gevil al yede qelap hechalaq shemmitztzad hashsheni shel hanneqeb. (Veken im hanneqeb hu mapsiq kol obyah, ella shennishar beorkah shead hanneqeb keshiur hekshero — hare hi mitkashsheret al yede shiur zeh, shehu chashub muqqap gevil gam betachtiyyuto al yede haqqelap hechalaq shellematta mehanneqeb (veim nishtayyer meorek [ot] zo gam lematta mehanneqeb — enah nipselet bekak, umitkashsheret hi al yede qelap hechalaq shebbetachtiyyuto, shekkevan shemmah shemmin hanneqeb ad qelap hechalaq eno ot acheret — eno chashub hepseq ben haot laggevil hammaqqipah, kemo shehanneqeb eno chashub hepseq). Abal im lo nishtayyer qelap chalaq kelal lematta mehanneqeb — pesula). Ulepi sebara zo, en chilluq ben neqeb shellipne hakketiba ben neqeb shelleachar hakketiba, shekkevan sheqqelap hechalaq shemmitztzad hashsheni shel hanneqeb mitztarep laot, lihyotah nechshebet muqqepet gevil gam bimqom hanneqeb, im ken ap im haya hanneqeb qodem hakketiba — eno posel yoter milleachar ketiba (kevan shennishtayyer shiur heksher ot shalem legamre beli shum neqeb). Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Veap-al-pi-ken yesh lachosh lassebara haacharona, lehachamir keshello nishtayyer qelap chalaq kelal mitztzad hashsheni shel hanneqeb, ben shehanneqeb hu chutz laot samuk lah mammash, ben shehu betokah umemalle kol chalalah. Veyesh omerim sheap lepi sebara haacharona — en haot tzarik lihyot muqqap gevil gam achar hakketiba ella mibbachutz, abal lo mibbipnim, vaapillu im hanneqeb shebbetokah memalle kol chalalah — keshera. Venakon lehachamir:

Veim nipseqa achat meotiyyot happeshutot sheen lahem ella yarek achat, kegon: va"v o zayi"n o nu"n peshuta, vekayyotze bahen — en shiur heksheran kimlo ot qetanna shehi yu"d, kemo beregel hahe"a vekayyotze bah, shehare va"v shello nishtayyer mimmenna ella kimlo yu"d — en zeh va"v kelal, veken bishar otiyyot happeshutot. Ella heksheran taluy biqriat hattinoq sheeno chakam velo tippesh, sheim hattinoq yodea liqrotan kehilkatan — kesherot, veim lav — pesulot. Abal tinoq chakam shemmebin hainyan dehaynu perush hammillot, hare hu omer haot hannipseqet mittok habanato shemmitparesh yapeh lepi hainyan, veen somekin alayv. Abal im eno chakam kol-kak lehabin hainyan, ap al pi shehu chakam behakkarat haotiyyot heteb — somekin alayv, vezeh lo tippesh sheameru. Umikkan atta lamed sheen tzarik lekassot millepanayv shear haotiyyot kemo shennohagin, sheim ken ap hechakam shemmebin hainyan sheqqore, mehekan yabin liqrot ot zo kehilkatah, kevan sheeno yodea inyanah uperushah. Umikkol maqom, ot shennipseqa beneqeb venishtayyer mimmenna gam lematta mehanneqeb — tzarik lekassot millepanayv mah shellematta mehanneqeb, lepi shehu yetzorpenna im mah shellemala mehanneqeb veyiqra haot kehilkatah, ubeemet enan mitztorpin, kevan shehanneqeb mapsiq benehem. Vehu haddin im mapsiq benehem serita haoberet boobi haot meeber leeber. Abal im enah oberet meeber leeber, apillu hayeta ken bishat hakketiba — enah poselet, kevan sheen haot chaluqa lishtayim legamre. Veeno domeh leneqeb shebbeemtza haobi shepposel im haya bishat hakketiba, lepi shemmiqtzat obi haot shemmitztzad zeh shel hanneqeb eno muqqap gevil bimqom hanneqeb, veken miqtzat obi shemmitztzad zeh shel hanneqeb, mah sheen ken bisrita shehi qelap chalaq, vachashuba heqqep gevil lemiqtzat haobi shehaot mitkashsheret bo, shello natenu shiur loobi haotiyyot, veyakol laasotan daqqot meod apillu lekattechilla. Veim hasserita oberet meeber leeber vehayeta ken beet hakketiba — yesh omerim sheen qeriat hattinoq moelet bah, apillu im yekassu millepanayv mah shellematta, shello hikshiru biqriat hattinoq ella beot shennikteba mittechilla arukka karauy veachar-kak nitqatztzera al yede hanneqeb o al yede serita. Veyesh omerim sheapillu hayeta qetzara mittechillatah vehattinoq qoreah kehilkatah — keshera, velaken im era shekkatab hassoper ezo ot meotiyyot happeshutot, umistappeq beshiur orkah im hi arukka kehilkatah, vei epshar lo lehaggiah mishshum shello kesidran kemo sheyyitbaer — mareh letinoq sheeno chakam velo tippesh vesomek alayv (veken iqqar. Veken nohagin):

En makshirin al yede qeriat hattinoq ella kesheanu mesuppaqim im orek haot hu kashshiur, o im rochab haot hu kashshiur, kegon d shennikteba qetanna keen yu"d, sheim hattinoq qoreah d' — keshera. Abal im yadua lanu sheen haot kehilkatah, apillu hattinoq qoreah kehilkatah — en zeh moil kelum, kegon shemmiqtzat yu"din shel haayni"n vehashshi"nin vehaal"pin, o ragle hattavi"n, enan nogein begup haot — pesulot, ap shehattinoq qorean kehilkatan, ki mah toil qeriat hattinoq veenenu root sheen haot kehilkatah. Umikkol maqom moelet qeriat hattinoq beotiyyot ellu, leinyan sheyyukal letaqqenan ap im katab acharehen, veen bazeh mishshum shello kesidran, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Veim nopla tippat deyo letok haot veenah nikkeret haot (ap al pi sheadayin hi muqqepet gevil betokah), kegon shennopla letok d' veniret kehe"a, o shennopla letok b' veniret kepe"a, o sheen shem b' aleha, o shennopla letok ot acheret veen shemah aleha, o shemmechasseret qetzat min haot, apillu enah mechasseret mimmenna ella qotzah vehu qotz shehaot nipselet bechesrono, o shenniret hattippa keillu hu gupah shel ot, ap al pi shehaot nikkeret heteb — pesula. Veen lah taqqana ligror hattippat deyo veal-yede-kak tihyeh haot ketiqqunah, mippene shehu kechaq tokot, dehaynu shechoqeq hattok shel ot, umimmela nishar tzurat ot bemah sheeno nigrar, vehattora omra: "uketabtam" velo vachaqaqtam, upereshu chakamim shebbechaq tokot hakkatub medabber. Vehu haddin im mocheq haddeyo beodo lach veal-yede-kak naaset haot ketiqnah — hare zeh kechaq tokot, sheen chilluq ben chaqiqa ugerira limchiqa, kevan sheeno ketiba, vehattora omra "uketabtam":

Veken im taa vekatab d' bimqom re"sh, o b' bimqom k' — en taqqana ligror o limchoq hattag, mippene shehu kechaq tokot. Abal yakol lehosip alayv deyo velaasoto agol kere"sh o keka"p, vehu shello katab adayin kelum achar ot zo, sheim lo ken pasul mishshum shello kesidran kemo sheyyitbaer. Veken im katab re"sh bimqom d' o k' bimqom b' — yakol lehosip deyo velaasotah merubbaat kehilkatah im lo katab achareha, shekkol shemmetaqqen al yede ketiba velo al yede gerira o mechiqa — kasher. Abal eno yakol ligror hakka"p laasotah kemo be"t, o hare"sh laasotah kedale"t:
Vekol zeh bigrirat deyo, abal im natap shaava al haotiyyot — gorerah vekasher. Veim muttar legorerah misseper tora beshabbat — yitbaer besiman sham:

Me"m petucha shennidbeqa petichatah venistema — en moil ligror haddebeq ulepotchah, mippene shehu kechaq tokot. Umah taqqanatah? Ligror kol hachartom vetishshaer betzurat nu"n kepupa, veachar-kak yiktob mah sheggarar, veen bazeh mishshum chaq tokot, ap al pi shello garar tzurat hannu"n vechazar uketabo mechadash, lepi shetztzurat hannu"n naasa mittechilla beheksher, ella shennipsela haot bingiat hachartom, laken day kesheggorer hachartom vechozer vekoteb mechadash. Abal re"sh shekketabah kemin d' — yesh lehachamir velomar shello day kesheyyigror hayyarek lebad o haggag lebad veyachazor veyiktebennu mechadash, mippene shebben haggag uben hayyarek naasa bipsul, shekken derek hassoperim shekkotebin techilla haggag im hattag shemmeachorayv veachar-kak hayyarek lematta, venimtza sheggam haggag naasa bipsul sheasa lo tag meachorayv, veen tzarik lomar hayyarek shennaasa achar asiyyat hattag, velaken tzarik ligror shenehem. Veap al pi sheyyesh lomar sheap kesheggorer echad mehem kevan shebbemah shennishar en bo tzurat ot kelal, im ken keshechozer vekoteb mah sheggarar — hare zeh kekoteb haot mittechillatah, ap-al-pi-ken en lehaqel leshayyer meuma min haot, kevan shekkullah naasa bipsul, sheap shehaggag kullah naasa beheksher raq haribbua shemmeacharayv bilbad hu happasul, mikkol maqom kevan shehakkol naasa biktiba achat — hare hakkol echad. Veken ka"p peshuta shetztzarik lihyot raglah arukka kiplayim kegaggah, shello tidmeh ler', veasa lah gag rachab keorek raglah, im eno yakol limshok raglah shettihyeh kiplayim kegaggah — tzarik limchoq kol haggag, hoil vekullah naaset biktiba achat. Vaapillu bemillat "eloheka" yakol limchoq, raq sheyyizzaher shello yimchoq haregel. Mah sheen ken bechartom shel me"m, sheeno naasa biktiba achat im tzurot hannu"n. Vehu haddin kol ot shenniktab bishte ketibot, kegon hag' vekayyotze bah — dinah keme"m:

Umikkol maqom, kol mah shekkatab beoto ot achar shennaasa bah happesul — tzarik legorero ulekotbo mechadash, ap al pi shello niktab biktiba achat im happesul, kegon yu"d haelyona shel ha' shehi nogaat baggag shettachteha yoter mimmah shetztzarik lihyot nogaat, sheen tzarik lihyot nogaat ella beoqtzah haymini velo beatzmah, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman l"v, vehu katab haggag samuk meod ad shennaga beatzmo shel yu"d — tzarik ligror kol haggag vehayyu"d shettachteha ulekotbah mechadash. Abal im oqtzah hassemali nogea baggag velo atzmah shel yu"d — kasher, sheap belo oqetz zeh shem yu"d aleha — eno posel bingiato. Veim yu"d hattachtona nogaat beatzmah laggag — en tzarik ligror haggag ella yu"d hattachtona bilbad shennaaset bipsul. Vehu haddin beregel hattay"v:

Veken haddin beyude"y hashshi"n vehaayi"n vehatztzadi"y vehappe"a shennageu begup haot beatzman velo beuqtzan bilbad — shetztzarik ligror kol mah shekkatab beoto ot achar shennaasa bah happesul. Veen qeriat hattinoq moelet bazeh kelal, kevan sheenenu root sheen haot ketiqqunah. Veken im nageu ragle hahe"a vehaqqu"p baggag apillu negia daqqa kechut hassaara, vetinoq sheeno chakam qorean kehilkatan — pesulot. Veen taqqana lehapridan, mishshum chaq tokot. Umikkol maqom, en tzarik ligror kol haot, ella day sheyyigror haregel shennaaset bipsul, veyachazor veyiktebenna, abal haggag veyarek yemini shennaasa mittechilla beheksher — en tzarik legoreran. Umikkol maqom, im katab mittechilla re"sh veachar-kak taa veasa lah tag keen dale"t — en lah taqqana bigrirat hattag bilbad, shekkevan sheen oseh maaseh begup haot, ella hi naaset re"sh al yede gerira bilbad — hare zeh kechaq tokot. Mah sheen ken behe"a vequ"p sheoseh maaseh begupan, sheggorer raglan vechozer vekoteban mechadash, vahare zeh keillu koteb kol haot, kevan sheen shem he"a vequ"p alehen beli regel zo. Ulepi zeh gam bere"sh shettaa veasa lah tag keen dale"t — yesh lehaqel bigrirat hattag im haggag bilbad o im hayyarek bilbad, kede laasot maaseh begup haot, vehashshear en tzarik ligror, kevan shennaasa beheksher mittechilla. Veap-al-pi-ken hammachamir ligror et kullah — tabo alayv beraka:

Vekol zeh keshehappesul hu betzurat gup haot, abal otiyyot hannogeot udebuqot zo bezo, ben shennidbeqa qodem shennigmera hashshenit shello hayeta alayv tzurat ot beheksher meolam, ben shennidbeqa achar shennigmera — yakol lehapridan besakkin vekasher. Veen bazeh mishshum chaq tokot, kevan shello haya pesulan begupan ella mechamat chesron heqqep gevil sabib lahen. Lepikak, im nishtanna tzurat haot al yede debiqatah lachabertah — en perud moil bah, vedinah keme"m shennistema, shekkol mah shenniktab bipsul — tzarik gerira. Veyesh omerim shehu haddin im kol orek haot debuqa lachabertah — en perud moil bahen:

Kol maqom sheen perud moil — en haabara bequlemus al haot moelet, shello yitztarek legorerah ulekotbah mechadash, shekkevan shekketab hattachton qayyam — en haelyon moil kelum, shekketab al gabbe ketab — eno ketab kelal, ella al gabbe haqqelap:

Kol maqom sheen perud moil vetzarik ligror velachazor veliktob apillu meat — en taqqana zo moelet ella kesheadayin lo katab kelum achar hattaut, abal im katab — tzarik limchoq kol mah shekkatab acharayv, velachazor veliktob hakkol achar sheyyetaqqen hattaut. Veim katab echad mishshemot sheenan nimchaqin — tzerika parasha zo geniza. Lepi shekkeshemmetaqqen hattaut al yede ketiba leachar shekkatab ezeh ot mehapparasha achar hattaut — nimtza parasha zo ketuba shello kesidrah, vehattora omra "vehayu" — bahavayatan yihyu. Abal otiyyot shennidbequ zo bezo beinyan shepperud moil bahen — yakol lehapridan apillu achar ketibat kol happarasha, veen bazeh mishshum koteb shello kesidran, kevan sheatta eno koteban, ella makshiran al yede gerirat haddebequt shebbenehem, ugerira enah ketiba. Vaapillu ot shemmakshiro al yede ketiba muetet, mikkol maqom im hayeta tzuratah aleha qodem laken bishat ketibata, velo hayeta niret kelal keot acheret, kegon hayyu"din sheal hashshi"nin veal haay"nin vehatztzadi"y veshel haal"pin upe"in veragle hatta"vin shello hayu nogein begup haot, vetinoq sheeno lo chakam velo tippesh qorean kehilkatan — yakol letaqqeno achar ken, veen bazeh mishshum shello kesidran. Abal im regel hahe"a o haqqu"p nogea baggag apillu negia daqqa kechut hassaara shetztzuratan alehen, vehattinoq qoreah kehilkatah, mikkol maqom kevan shetztzarik ligror techilla kol haregel, im ken shub en tzuratan alehen, ukeshechozer vekoteban — hare zeh koteb shello kesidran. Veken bishar negiot shetztzarik ligror haot ad shettapsid tzuratah — i epshar letaqqenah achar ken, kegon yu"d haelyona vehattachtona shel haale"p vehashshi"n vehaayi"n vehatztzadi"y vehappe"a veregel hattay"v shehen nogein begup haot yoter meharauy beinyan shennipsela, veken me"m petucha shennistema vekol kayyotze bazeh. Vaapillu bemaqom sheen tzarik gerira kelal, ella ketiba mashshehu bilbad, mikkol maqom im haot chaluqa lishtayim veniret kishte otiyyot, kegon tzadi"y shekketabah yu"d nu"n, o shi"n shekketabah ayi"n yu"d, ap al pi shehattinoq sheeno chakam qorean kehilkatan — eno yakol letaqqeno achar kak, shekkevan sheenenu root sheyyesh lahen tzurat otiyyot acherot, im ken keshemmetaqqenam achar kak — hare zeh kiktiba mechadash, vahare zeh kotebah shello kesidrah. Veken che"t shekketabah shene zay"nin, uperidatan nikkeret heteb tekep umiyyad sheroin otan, abal im en nikkeret peridat hachatotarot sheal gabbe zay"nin ad shemmistakkel bah — yakol letaqqenan achar-kak. Vaapillu im hattinoq qorean zay"nin — en holekin acharayv beot zo, lepi sheen hattinoq murgal bech' kazo sheim hachatotarot. (Abal betzadi"y veshi"n holekin achar qeriat hattinoq ben lehaqel ben lehachamir, ella im ken enenu root shehen: yu"d nu"n, o ayi"n yu"d — en mashgichin al hattinoq). Veken im lo asa regel yemanit shel yu"d — en lah taqqana achar-kak, apillu im hattinoq qoreah ketiqqunah, mippene sheen shem yu"d aleha belo regel zo, venimtza koteb shello kesidran. Abal im lo asa oqetz hassemali — yakol letaqqen achar-kak, sheap belo oqetz zeh — shem yu"d aleha, veen baasiyyato mishshum koteb shello kesidran:

Hakketiba — tzerika lihyot lishmah, sheyyiktob happarashiyyot leshem qedushshat tepillin beperush. Veim ketaban setam — pesulot. Vehaazkarot — tzarik lekotban leshem qedushshatan beperush. Veim ketaban setam — yigganezu. Veyesh lehistappeq bekol maqom shetztzarik lishmah, im day bemachashaba sheyyachashob belibbo sheoseh dabar zeh leshem mah shetztzarik laasoto, kegon happarashiyyot leshem qedushshatan vehaazkarot leshem qedushshatan, o im tzarik lehotzi ken bispatayv velo day bemachashaba lebad. Vesapeq shel tora — lehachamir. Vetzarik sheyyomar bepiv behatchalat hakketiba: ani koteb parashiyyot ellu leshem qedushshat tepillin. Umillebad zeh, bekol paam shekkoteb azkara — tzarik sheyyomar shekkotebah leshem qedushshat hashshem, veim lo amar ken beperush biktibat haazkarot, ella chosheb ken belibbo — kesherot bediabad, hoil vehotzi bitchillat hakketiba bepiv shekkoteban lishman. Abal im lo hotzi mippiv bitchillat hakketiba — yesh lehachamir beshel tora velipsol apillu bediabad, ap al pi shechishsheb belibbo. Abal beibbud haorot — yesh lehaqel bediabad im chashab belibbo bitchillat haibbud shemmeabbedan leshem seper tora o tepillin, ap al pi shello hotzi bispatayv, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheen tzarik ibbud lishmah ella lemitzva min hammubchar, abal bediabad kasher ap al pi shemmeubbad shello lishmo. Veap sheen dibrehem iqqar, mikkol maqom yesh lismok al zeh lehaqel bediabad keshechishsheb belibbo ap al pi shello hotzi bispatayv, kevan sheyyesh lehistappeq shemma day bemachashaba lebaddah apillu lekattechilla:

Keshebba lehitnamnem — lo yiktob, mippene sheeno koteb az bekavvana lishmah (sheap shellomar bepiv eno tzarik ella bitchillat hakketiba, mikkol maqom bemachashabto tzarik lihyot bekol hakketiba shekkoteb leshem tepillin velo kemitasseq beolma, kemo shebbeget tzarik lihyot bemachashabto bekol torep hagget shekkotebo lishmo velishmah kemo shennitbaer lemala):

Tzarik ledaqdeq meod bachaserot viterot, sheim chaser o yattir ot achat — pesulin hattepillin, venimtza hammenichim otan — mebarekin bekol yom beraka lebattala, vegam sheruyin bekol yom belo mitzvat tepillin. Venimtza onesh hassoper merubbeh. Laken tzarik lihyot meod yere shamayim vechared lidbar Hashem hammitasseq biktibat hattepillin vetiqqunam. Vegam tzarik lehazhir velimchot besoperim hammannichim lenaarehem liktob tepillin o mezuzot, veim roeh shenniktebu kehilkatan — azay mokeran, vehu machati et harabbim umakshilan bitpillin umezuzot pesulin, ki hannaar — naar, veeno mekavven biktibato ella leyappot hakketab lehitlammed ulehitraggel bo, velo leshem qedushsha vekavvanat mitzva baolam, vahare onesh hassoper merubbeh meod, veatid litten et haddin uleqabbel onsho harbeh meod, vealayv neemar: "arur oseh meleket Hashem remiyya", laken yizzaher kol soper mizzeh, vetob lo:

Tob lenassot haqqulemus qodem sheyyatchil liktob happarasha, shello yehe alayv deyo yoter midday veyapsid. Veken yizzaher im tob haqqulemus liktob bo et hashshem, shello yatchil liktob et hashshem miyyad shello yapsidennu beribbuy haddeyo, ella yaaseh kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman rav. Veken yizzaher qodem sheyyiktob kol shem, leayyen veliqrot kol mah shekkatub beotah parasha shello yihyeh sham pesul, velo yabo hashshem lide geniza al yado. Veachar sheyyashlim happarasha yiqraenna kullah bekavvana vediqduq heteb paamayim veshalosh qodem sheyyiktob parasha sheniyya, veken bashsheniyya ubashshelishit. Umillebad zeh, tob sheyyachazor veyiqra kol parasha bitpillin shel rosh qodem sheyyittenenna betok beto, shemma titchallep lo beacheret. Velamma yachazor ledaqdeq ulehaggiah kol parasha achar shehishlimah? Mippene sheim yimtza ezeh chesron ot beezeh parasha lo hi lebaddah nipsela, ella kol mah shelleachareha gam ken nipsal al yadah, mishshum sheyyihyu shello kesidran im parasha hammuqdemet sheyyiktob mechadash leacharehen. Veken mittaam zeh eno yakol litlot haot shennechsera ben hashshitot kederek shettolin beseper tora lepi shebbitpillin neemar: "vehayu" — bahavayatan yihyu, shetztzarik lihyot kesidran, veken bimzuza:

Abal im yitter ot achat — yesh lah taqqana al yede sheyyigror otah, im hi besop hatteba o bitchillatah. Abal im hi beemtza hatteba — peamim sheen tiqqun moil, mishshum shekkesheyyigrerenna yihyeh nireh kishte tebot, upeamim shettiqqun moil al yede sheyyigrerenna veyimshok haot shellepaneha shettemalle meqomah velo tihyeh hatteba chaluqa, kegon "laaboteka" shekkatab male vay"v achar hab' — yigrerenna veyimshok hab' shellepaneha shettemalle meqomah. Veken im hattiqqun taluy beka"p o dale"t o re"sh sheepshar lehamshikan meat lemalle meqom ot haytera shennigrera. Abal im haotiyyot sheepshar lehamshikan hen achar ot haytera, shei epshar lehamshikan laachorehem ad sheyyigror mehem techilla, kegon seor shekkatab male vay"v achar haale"p, shei epshar limshok hare"sh leachareha ad sheyyigror raglah techilla, venimtza shebbittel tzuratah, ukeshemmetaqqenah achar-kak — nimtza koteb shello kesidran. Veen taqqana, ella im ken yakol lemalloot meqomo al yede sheyyeabbeh qetzat haot shellepaneha veshelleachareha, sheen bazeh mishshum shinnuy haot. Mah sheen ken keshehaotiyyot sheepshar lehamshikan hen lipne haot haytera — azay epshar lehamshikan harbeh mibbeli sheyyiggara mehem kelum:

Omnam yesh lehistappeq be"matztzot", shemmishpatah lihyot chaser, uketabah male — im moil arikut hatztzadi"y lematta achar sheyyigror havvay"v, ki shemma kol od sheeno maarik haot lemala nechshebet kishte tebot. Veken be"noten" shemmishpatah lihyot chaser — im moil arikut hannu"n lematta achar gerirat havvay"v. Umikkol maqom kol shenniret kishte tebot — pesula. Abal im bitchillat hakketiba mamshik regel hattachton shel hannu"n vehatztzadi"y vekoteb haot hassemuka betokah kazeh: — kasher, ubilbad shello yimshok yoter midday. Veim himshik yoter midday kede lemalloot hashshita — yesh lehistappeq im kasher im lav. Veyesh leharot letinoq sheeno lo chakam velo tippesh, kemo sheosin bekol ot sheyyesh bah sapeq, kemo sheyyitbaer siman lv:

Im katab teba achat yetera — yigrerenna veyihyeh meqomah chalaq. Veap sheen tzarik lihyot sham chalaq — en zeh posel, kol sheen bimqom hechalaq keshiur harevach shebben parasha leparasha, shehu kede tesha otiyyot. Veim siyyum hatteba shellepaneha hu ot he"a o qu"p — eno yakol lehamshikan lemalloot meqom hechalaq, mippene sheregel hahe"a vehaqu"p tzarik lihyot besopan, veim yigror haregel veyiktebennu bassop — nimtza koteb shello kesidran. Abal im yihyeh chalaq keshiur tesha otiyyot kesheyyigror teba haytera, venimtza sheyyihyeh revach shebben parasha leparasha bemaqom sheen sham parasha veyippaselu hattepillin — yesh lehaqel limshok hahe"a ap al pi shello tehe raglah besopa, meachar shello huzkar zeh battalmud:

Haya koteb vetaa umechaqo beodo lach, o shennityabbesh ugeraro, veken im napal deyo al haqqelap umechaqo beodo lach, o geraro leachar shennityabbesh — muttar liktob al meqom hammechaq, o al meqom haggerar apillu haazkara, kemo shemmuttar beseper tora. Umikkol maqom, tob lekattechilla shello yimchoq beodo lach, ella yeyabbeshennu yapeh baesh, ki az yiggarer beqal, velo yishshaer lo shum rashem:
Nidbaq ot lachabertah beotiyyot hashshem — yakol legoreran ulehapridan, veen bigrira zo mishshum mocheq et hashshem, shehare metaqqen hu bazeh:

Otiyyot vetebot shennimchaqu qetzat, im rishshuman nikkar kol-kak shettinoq sheeno lo chakam velo tippesh yakol liqrotan — muttar lehaabir qulemos alehen lehetib hakketab ulechaddesh, veen bazeh mishshum shello kesidran, kevan sheggam akshav hakketab hu kasher, umah shemmosip alayv eno ella shemmeshammero shello yitmacheq yoter. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheqqetzat tzeba haddeyo qayyam, abal im qapatz kol haddeyo mehaqqelap velo nishar raq rashem admimut mehachaludda shel haddeyo, keshemmaabir haqulemos alehen — hare zeh koteb shello kesidran. Veen tzarik lomar im bitchillat hakketiba lo haya haddeyo shachor ella domeh lelaban shehukha marito, o leadom, vetzarik lehaabir alehen qulemos — sheyyesh bazeh mishshum shello kesidran:

Yesh lizzaher lekattechilla shello yikkanes rosh hallame"d shel shita zo betok avir hahe"a vehache"t shebbashshita shellemala mimmennu, apillu belo negia. Veim niknesu beinyan shehipsid tzurat haot, kegon shenniknas letok dale"t veniret kehe"a — pesula:
Im en happarashiyyot shegurot bepiv — tzarik sheyyiktob mittok hakketab, shemma yiteh. Veim miqtzat happarasha shegura bepiv — muttar liktob oto miqtzat beal peh, vehashshear mittok hakketab:

Keshekkoteb beal peh mippene shehen shegurot bepiv — tzarik liqrot kol teba bepiv qodem sheyyiktebenna, shemma yiteh veyaqdim hamucharot mechamat shegiruto bahen. Vaapillu im echad maqri oto milla bemilla — tzarik hu gam ken lehotzi kol milla umilla bepiv. Abal im koteb mittok hakketab — en tzarik lehotzi bepiv, sheriyyato bakketab shellepanayv moelet kemo haqqeria bepiv. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehen shegurot bepiv, veap-al-pi-ken koteb mittok hakketab, abal im enam shegurot bepiv, shetztzarik hu liktob mittok hakketab — en reiyyato bakketab moelet lo leshello yitztarek lehotzi kol teba bepiv qodem sheyyiktebenna:
Apillu mittok hakketab eno rashshay liktob ella mi shehu yodea liqrot, sheim eno yodea liqrot ap al pi sheyyodea liktob haotiyyot — yakol litot beqal veeno margish:

Tzarik lehaniach chalaq bekol parasha lemala ulematta mehashshitot kemo chatzi tzipporen. Yesh omerim sheshshiur zeh lemala hu kede gaggah shel lame"d, ulematta keshiur k' venu"n peshutim, kede sheggam hem yihyu muqqapim gevil im yizdammenu sham. Veyesh omerim shetztzarik lehaniach chalaq kachatzi tzipporen lemala lemala miggaggo shel lame"d, ulematta lematta mik' venu"n peshuta. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla. Abal bitchillat happarasha ubesopah — en tzarik lehaniach kelal. Ak hassoperim nahagu lehaniach qetzat battechilla ubassop:

Tzarik lizzaher lekattechilla lehaniach ben teba leteba kimlo ot qetanna shehi yu"d, ubediabad en lipsol, ella im ken niret keteba achat letinoq sheeno lo chakam velo tippesh, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman rad beseper tora. Veken lekattechilla tzarik lizzaher shello yihyeh ben ot leot ella kechut hassaara, ubediabad en lipsol, ella im ken niret hatteba chaluqa lishtayim letinoq sheeno lo chakam velo tippesh, kemo shekkatub sham beseper tora. Veyesh omerim shellekattechilla tzarik lehaniach gam ken ben shita leshita kimlo shita, kemo beseper tora. Veyesh omerim sheen tzarik ledaqdeq bazeh ella beseper tora. Veken nahagu hassoperim sheen medaqdeqin bazeh bitpillin ubimzuzot:

Ben beseper tora ben bitpillin umezuzot — en lehaniach chalaq kelal ben pasuq lepasuq yoter mibben teba leteba bepasuq echad, mippene sheen anu beqiim behepseq happesuqim shennipsequ lemosheh missinay. Umikkol maqom im heniach — lo pasal, im lo heniach keshiur revach shebben parasha leparasha, shehi lekattechilla keshalosh tebot "asher asher asher" meoto hakketab, ubediabad ketesha otiyyot qetannot shehen yu"din shel oto hakketab, kemo shekkatub beyoreh dea siman arah:

Lekattechilla yesh lizzaher laasot kol hashshurot shavot, shello tehe achat nikneset veachat yotzet, vaapillu ot achat. Umikkol maqom im nizdammena lo teba bat chamesh otiyyot besop hashshita veeno yakol lekotbah betok hashshita beoto ketab shehu koteb bo — yakol liktob shalosh otiyyot mimmenna betok hashshita ushettayim chutz lashshita, abal lo shettayim betok hashshita veshalosh chutz lashshita. Vaapillu teba bat shemoneh otiyyot — lo yiktob chamesh mimmenna betok hashshita veshalosh chutz lashshita, ap al pi sherob hatteba betok hashshita. Vaapillu shette otiyyot im hen teba achat — lo yiktob otan chutz lashshita. Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad apillu katab teba bat harbeh otiyyot chutz lashshita — lo pasal:

Otiyyot hashshem, ben shem hamyuchad ben shear shemot sheenan nimchaqin, vaapillu hannitpal lashshem meacharayv — tzarik sheyyihyu kullam betok hashshita velo yetze mehen kelal chutz lashshita lekattechilla. Ubediabad — kasher bitpillin (shei epshar letaqqenan mishshum shello kesidran). Abal beseper tora — yakol limchoq kol hashshurot haelyonot, im en bahem shum shem mishshemot sheenan nimchaqin, veachar-kak yimshok otan ad shettihyena shavot im hashshem hayyotze:

Arba parashiyyot shel yad, hoil vehen niktabot biqlap echad veshayyak bahen petucha usetuma, shekkeshemmeniach maqom chalaq besop shita acharona shel parasha rishona kede tesha otiyyot umatchil parasha shelleachareha berosh hashshita baddap hashsheni — hare parasha shelleachareha niqret petucha, kemo shebbeseper tora niqret parasha hammatchelet berosh haddap parasha petucha, kesheyyesh revach kede tesha otiyyot lepaneha besop shita acharona shebbaddap haqqodem. Lepikak tzarik liktob beshel yad kol parasha kemo shehi beseper tora, im petucha — petucha, veim setuma — setuma. Dehaynu shetztzarik lehaniach maqom chalaq kede tesha otiyyot besop shita acharona shebbeparashat "qaddesh", kede shepparashat "vehaya ki yebiaka" sheyyatchil berosh hashshita harishona shebbaddap hashsheni tihyeh parasha petucha kemo shehi battora. Veim asaah setuma — pesula. Abal parashat "qaddesh" — lo shayyak bah petucha usetuma, kevan sheen katub lepaneha kelum battepillin, velaken matchilin otah berosh hashshita harishona veen menichin lepaneha kelum, ap al pi shebbattora hi petucha, shekkevan sheen ketuba lepaneha kelum — en leka petucha gedola mizzo sheen ketab acher sotemah. Ubesop shita acharona shebbeparashat "vehaya ki yebiaka" — tzarik lehaniach maqom chalaq kede tesha otiyyot, kede shepparashat "shema" sheyyatchil berosh shita harishona shebbaddap hashshelishi tihyeh petucha kemo shehi battora. Veim asaah setuma — pesula. Abal parashat "vehaya im shamoa" shehi setuma battora — tzerika lihyot gam ken setuma battepillin. Veim asaah petucha — yesh mi shepposel. Veyesh makshirin bediabad, sheap shebbattora hi setuma, mikkol maqom kevan shebbattora enah semuka kelal leparashat "shema" — en zeh nechshab shinnuy mah sheharevach shebbenah leparashat "shema" hu patuach velo satum, kemo shessatum harevach shellepaneha battora, kevan sheggam battora en harevach satum beparashat "shema" shellepaneha, veyesh benah leparashat "shema" shebbattora revach harbeh patuach. Mah sheen ken parashat "shema", ap sheenah semuka battora leparashat "vehaya ki yebiaka" — en zeh moil kelal leshello yitztarek laasot petucha. Veken iqqar. Abal im en lepaneha revach kelal benah leparashat "shema" beezeh shita mishshitot haddappin shellahen, lo baddap shellah velo baddap shel parashat "shema", dehaynu shehitchil otah berosh shita haelyona shebbaddap velo heniach revach kelal lepaneha beotah shita, velo besop shita shel parashat "shema", o sheheniach revach veen bo keshiur revach shebben parasha leparasha, dehaynu kede liktob tesha otiyyot — hare zeh nechshab (shinnuy gamur) mimmah shehi ketuba battora, upesula apillu diabad. Ella tzarik lihyot lepaneha revach satum, kemo lipne kol parasha setuma shebbattora. Abal besopah — en tzarik lehaniach shum revach. Veken nohagin lesayyem "al haaretz" besop shita hattachtona:

Usetuma shebbattora — yesh lah arba tzurot, achat ledibre hakkol, veshalosh nechlequ bahen haramba"m vehara"sh. Hammakshir bezo — posel bezo, vehammakshir bezo — posel bezo. Dehaynu, sheim siyyem ezeh parasha bitchillat ezeh shita vekatab apillu teba achat meotah parasha berosh shita zo, veachar-kak heniach maqom chalaq kede tesha otiyyot beshita zo, veachar-kak hitchil parasha shelleachareha beshita zo atzmah vekatab apillu teba achat beshita zo mipparasha shelleachareha — hare parasha shelleachareha niqret setuma ledibre hakkol. Abal im siyyem ezo parasha besop hashshita, o bepachot mikkede tesha otiyyot missop hashshita, veheniach chalaq bashshita shelleachareha kede tesha otiyyot, vehitchil parasha shelleachareha — hare parasha zo shelleachareha niqret petucha lehara"sh. Abal leharamba"m gam zo setuma hi, ben shehi bashshita shelleachareha beoto haddap, ben shehi berosh dap hashsheni raq sheen shita shelema penuya benehem lo besop dap harishon velo berosh dap hashsheni, kemo sheyyitbaer leqamman. Vehu haddin im siyyem ezeh parasha veheniach chalaq kede tesha otiyyot besop shita zo achar shessiyyem happarasha, velo hitchil parasha shelleachareha miyyad berosh shita shelleachareha, ella heniach meat revach apillu pachot mikkede tesha otiyyot, veachar-kak hitchil parasha shelleachareha — hare parasha zo shelleachareha niqret setuma leharamba"m, shekkol sheen happarasha matchelet berosh hashshita veyesh lepaneha revach kede tesha otiyyot, ben beotah shita ben bashshita shellepaneha — hi setuma leharamba"m, apillu hi berosh dap hashsheni. Abal lehara"sh kol sheyyesh revach bikde tesha otiyyot ben berosh hashshita ben besop hashshita — hare happarasha shelleachareha niqret petucha. Veim siyyem ezeh parasha besop shita, o bepachot mikkede tesha otiyyot missop hashshita, veheniach shita achat shelema penuya, vehitchil parasha shelleachareha berosh shita shelishit, o bepachot mikkede tesha otiyyot meroshah — lehara"sh nechshab maqom hechalaq shel shita happenuya shebben happarashiyyot haellu keillu hu chalaq beemtza shita ben shette parashiyyot, vahare happarasha hashsheniyya niqret setuma. Abal leharamba"m hi petucha, ben shessiyyum parasha harishona vehatchalat hashsheniyya hakkol bedap echad, ben shehen bishne dappin vehashshita happenuya hi besop dap harishon o berosh dap hashsheni:

Vehinneh, bitpillin i epshar laasot parashat "vehaya im shamoa" shettehe setuma ledibre hakkol, shehare en kotebin lepaneha kelum beotah shita shemmatchilin otah bah, shepparashat "shema" mistayyemet bedap bipne atzmo vehi bedap bipne atzmo, veim yatchil otah berosh hashshita shebberosh haddap veyaniach revach besop parashat "shema" kede tesha otiyyot — tihyeh petucha ledibre hakkol, ubattora hi setuma. Veim lo yaniach revach kede tesha otiyyot — kol shekken sheenah kemo shehi battora, sheenah niqret kelal parasha bipne atzmah kesheen kede tesha otiyyot revach lepaneha. Ella en lah taqqana, [ella] o laasotah setuma lehara"sh velo leharamba"m, kegon sheyyaniach shita achat penuya veyatchilenna bashshita hashsheniyya, o laasotah setuma leharamba"m velo lehara"sh, kegon shello yatchilenna berosh hashshita, ella yaniach lepaneha revach kede tesha otiyyot berosh hashshita, sheaz hi setuma leharamba"m. Umikkol maqom, yizzaher shello lehaniach revach besop parashat "shema" kede tesha otiyyot. Veap al pi shebbeseper tora im era shennishar besop hashshita kede tesha otiyyot veen sham od meat revach liktob teba achat mipparasha shelleachareha beshita zo — ap-al-pi-ken hi parasha setuma keshemmeniach meat revach bashshita shelleachareha, shepparasha petucha hi leolam berosh hashshita, ukesheenah berosh hashshita hi setuma leharamba"m, umikkol maqom kevan sheharevach shebbesop hashshita hu siman liptucha, shekkesheen sham revach acher zulato bashshita shelleachareha — tihyeh happarasha shelleachareha petucha, ukesheen revach kashshiur besop hashshita — hi siman shelleachareha tihyeh setuma, im ken bitpillin shebbeyad hassoper laasot kemo sheyyirtzeh — yesh lo lesayyem parashat "shema" besop shita, o bepachot mikkede tesha otiyyot missop hashshita, kede lehorot shepparasha shelleachareha hi setuma. Velo amaran sheap im meniach revach kede tesha otiyyot besop hashshita — ap-al-pi-ken parasha shelleachareha setuma kesheenah matchelet berosh hashshita, ella im era lo ken beseper tora, sheeno rashshay lehamshik haotiyyot o leqatztzer bishbil revach shebben parasha leparasha kemo shekkatub beyoreh dea siman rag. Veim era lo sheheniach battepillin kede tesha otiyyot besiyyum parashat "shema" — en tzarik lehaniach bitchillat parasha shelleachareha kede tesha otiyyot, ella meat revach. Abal im lo heniach kede tesha otiyyot besiyyum parashat shema velo behatchalat parasha shelleachareha, ap al pi shebbetzerup shenehem yachad yehe kede tesha otiyyot veyoter — en mitztorpin zeh im zeh, vahare en kan (petucha) [parasha] kelal, kevan sheen revach tesha otiyyot bemaqom echad. Veyesh mi sheomer shemmitztorpin zeh im zeh, venaasa al yede ken parasha shelleachareha setuma leharamba"m, veepshar gam lehara"sh. Velaken yesh laasot ken lekattechilla, kede latzet yede shenehem lepi debarayv. Abal yesh lachosh lassebara harishona shello lehaknis et atzmo lispeq tepillin pesulin, shehare lepi sebara harishona, sheen kan parashah kelal — hen pesulin allibba dekulle olma apillu bediabad, mah sheen ken kesheasaah petucha — haiqqar kehammakshirim bediabad:

Vekevan shei epshar laasotah setuma ledibre hakkol — nohagin beharbeh medinot laasotah setuma leharamba"m, lepi shekken iqqar ap beseper tora im i epshar laasot ledibre hakkol, kemo shekkatub beyoreh dea siman arah. Abal bimdinot ellu nohagin laasotah petucha kemo happarashiyyot shellepaneha, lepi sheyyesh mi shemmattir laasotah petucha apillu lekattechilla, hoil veenah semuka battora leparashat "shema". Veap sheen debarayv iqqar, mikkol maqom kevan shehaiqqar hu shebbediabad kasher bekol inyan, vei epshar laasotah setuma ledibre hakkol — sameku haacharonim al debarayv shello lebattel hamminhag, kede shello lehotzi laaz al harishonim:
Vekol zeh bitpillin shel yad, abal bitpillin shel rosh shehapparashiyyot niktabim al arbaa qelapim — en lehaqpid bahen biptuchot usetumot. Ak nahagu lehaqpid:

"Totapot" sheomra tora bitpillin shel rosh, qibbelu chakamim shehen arbaa battim shel or learba parashiyyot, kol parasha bebayit bipne atzmo. Velapparashiyyot shel tepillin shel yad — bayit echad shel or, shenneemar: "vehaya leka leot" — ot achat amarti, velo yoter:

Veor habbattim ben shel yad ben shel rosh — tzarik lihyot mibbehema chayya vaop hattehorim, apillu minnebelot uterepot shellahen, raq shehu min hammuttar bepika. Verashshay laasot habbattim miqqelap, sheggam hu niqra or. Veyesh mi sheomer sheen laasot battim miqqelap, ella im ken sheyyasim haqqelap beme qelippat etzim (sheqqorin bilshon ashkenaz: lm"a) shemmeabbedin bahem orot. Vetob lachosh lidbarayv lekattechilla. Verashshay laasot meor shelil, sheggam hi niqret or leinyan zeh, ap al pi shehi kebasar leinyan tuma. Veken haretzuot yakol laasotan miqqelap veor shelil. Veyesh omerim sheor shelil hu yoter hagun lemitzva, ki lo neebda bo abera, shello haya bo tashmish shel zakar uneqeba. Veyesh mi sheomer sheachar or shelil — yoter hagun or op, veachar-kak or hachayya, veachar-kak or habbehema hakkeshera, veachar-kak or nebela uterepa:

Or habbattim — tzarik sheyyehe meubbad lishmo, kemo qelap happarashiyyot. Veyesh omerim sheeno domeh liqlap happarashiyyot, shehapparashiyyot hen iqqar haqqedushsha, abal habbattim hen tepelim umeshammeshim lahem, veen tzarik ibbud lishmo. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem keshei epshar beinyan acher, kede shello lehitbattel mimmitzvat tepillin. Veyakol gam ken lebarek alehen ad sheyyimtza acherim:

Arbaa battim shel rosh tzerikim lihyot meor echad, shenneemar: "ulezikkaron ben eneka" — zikkaron echad amarti leka, velo b' veg' zikronot. Vachatikot or tepurim yachad chashubim keor echad (vehu haddin im hem debuqim bedebeq). Umikkol maqom tob venakon laasotam meor echad mammash, shennotelin or egel harak umaknisin oto bacharitze haddepus, umannichin oto kak ad sheyyityabbesh, venotelin haddepus mittoko, venimtzeu habbattim asuyim mealehem:

Tepillin ben shel yad ben shel rosh — halaka lemosheh missinay shettihyena merubbaot ribbua mekuvvan sheorko kerochbo, beinyan shealaksono yihyeh odep al orko shene chumshe orko beqerub. Veribbua zeh tzarik lihyot mekuvvan bahen ben bimqom moshaban shehi hattittora, shetztzerika lihyot merubbaat kemo sheyyitbaer, ben betipran, shettehe hattepira merubbaat mammash orkah kerochbah, ben begup habbattim, sheyyihyeh habbayit merubba orko kerochbo (bekol meshek gobho). Abal al gobho en lehaqpid im hu yoter meorko verochbo. Veim hayu merubbaim, veachar-kak nitqalqel ribbuan beechad mimmeqomot ellu — tzarik letaqqenan. Veim lo tiqqenan — pesulim, kevan sheribbuan hi halaka lemosheh missinay. Veshel rosh yihyeh kol haarbaa battim yachad merubbain, velo kol echad bipne atzmo. Ulekattechilla yaaseh kol haarbaa battim shavin, shello yehe echad rachab mechabero:
Or habbattim — mitzva laasotan shachor kemo haretzuot. Veap al pi shebbaretzuot hu halaka lemosheh missinay, velo battim, mikkol maqom mitzvat tepillin hu sheyyihyeh hakkol shachor:

Charitz shebben bayit lebayit — tzarik sheyyaggia ad meqom hatteper. Veim lo higgia — keshera, vehu sheyyihyeh nikkar hecharitz lemala, kede sheyyihyeh arbaa rasheha nirot lakkol. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheasa mechitztzot habbattim mibbipnim gam ben bayit lebayit milmala ad sop rochab happarasha meor echad im mechitztzot hachitzonim, abal im lo asa ken, o sheasa ken veniqra achar-kak haor shebben parasha leparasha — pasul, kemo sheyyitbaer siman lag:

Gobah habbattim en lahem shiur, veyakol laasotan gedolim o qetannim kemo sheyyirtzeh. Vehamminhag shel hachakamim vaabot batte dinim laasot shel rosh gebohim yoter mishshalosh etzbaot, kevan shemmenichin otan begilluy, veyesh shebach begilluyan, kemo shennitbaer siman kaz. Abal hachakamim vetalmidim, vetalmid bipne rabbo sheen derek eretz legallot tepillin bepanayv — menichin tepillin qetannot keetzba umechetza tachat hammitznepet, mippene derek eretz shello yashvu et atzmam lerabbotehen bipnehem, venirin keazzut panim, mippene shehattepillin hem derek kabod ugedulla, kemo shekkatub: "verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Hashem niqra aleka veyareu mimmeka", vedareshu raza"l: "ellu tepillin shebbarosh":

Veken orek verochab habbattim — en lo shiur. Abal orek verochab hattittora — yesh lah shiur, sheyyihyeh lekattechilla yoter mikkeetzba lekol happachot, (yag) shehare ameru chakamim: "maqom yesh barosh lehaniach shene tepillin", veim hayu kesherim biketzba — haya maqom lehaniach shelosha tepillin. Vehaggeonim ameru shehabbattim shel rosh tzerikim lihyot etzbaayim al etzbaayim lekattechilla, veim pichet — lo pasal. Ubattim shel yad etzba al etzba lekattechilla. Vekol etzba setam hi gudal. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem, ap shello nahagu ken:

Shi"n shel tepillin — halaka lemosheh missinay, sheyyaaseh beor habbattim shel rosh kemin shi"n boletet miqqimte haor, echad mimino veechad missemolo. Veqibbelu haggeonim shehashshi"n shel yemin hammeniach tihyeh shel shelosha rashim, veshel semol hammeniach shel arbaa rashim, veim hapak — lo pasal. Vehayyu"din shel hashshi"nin, ben beshel shelosha rashim ben beshel arbaa rashim — tzerikim ligga lematta beshule hashshi"nin. Vechuddan shel shule hashshi"nin — tzarik sheyyaggia ad meqom hatteper lekattechilla, velo yamshik hashshi"nin harbeh, ella sheggam chuddan shel shulehen yihyeh nireh al hatteper lekattechilla:

Yesh omerim shehashshi"nin tzerikim lihyot miqqimte haor, veim asaan bidpus — lo yatza, mippene shehu kechaq tokot, sheap shehashshi"nin habboletot bidpus dochaqot haor vechoqeqot bo tzuratah, vahare zeh chaqiqat gup haotiyyot velo tokah, mikkol maqom haor shehu rak nidchaq gam sebibat belitat hashshi"n shebbaddepus, al yede depus hashsheni sheggup hashshi"n shoqea bo vetokoteha boletin bo vedochaqin tokot hashshi"n baor, vahare zeh chaq tokot. Veyesh omerim sheen lachosh beshi"n zo lechaq tokot, shello paselu chaq tokot ella beparashiyyot shel tepillin umezuzot, veken beseper tora ubeget, shenneemar bahen ketiba battora, ketiba — velo chaqiqa, abal beshi"n zo lo neemar bahalaka lemosheh missinay ketiba bah. Veken hamminhag pashut laasotah bidpus. Veap-al-pi-ken tob lachosh lassebara harishona:

Tittora shel tepillin — halaka lemosheh missinay, ben beshel yad ben beshel rosh, tittora hu gesher belashon arammi, dehaynu sheyyasim or lematta lekassot pi habbattim, venireh keen dap shel gesher. Veken mabarta shel tepillin — halaka lemosheh missinay, ben beshel yad ben beshel rosh, dehaynu sheor hattittora yihyeh arok ubolet mitztzad echad, vehabbelita tihyeh kepula laabor haretzua betokah, veal ken niqra belita zo mabarta. Ulepi shehalaka lemosheh missinay shemmeqom moshab hattepillin dehaynu hattittora yihyeh merubba mammash, lepikak tzarik lachtok hammabarta mishshene tzedadin (bammaqom shemmistayyem ribbua hattittora), shello tehe hammabarta rechaba (sham) kemo rochab hattittora, kede sheyyihyeh nikkar ribbua hattittora:
Tzarik liglol kol parasha missopah litchillatah keshennotenah betok betah, kemo shemmezuza niglelet me"echad" kelappe "shema", velo lehippuk, mittaam shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman rapach:

Yesh omerim shehalaka lemosheh missinay likrok et happarashiyyot bematlit o biqlap, veim lo kerakan — pesulin. Veyesh choleqin. Venahagu lekorkan biqlap lekattechilla, abal im lo kerakan — kesherot bediabad, im en lo acherim. Veyesh maqpidin millekorkan ella biqlap hakkasher lebattim uretzuot, shekkevan shekkerika zo halaka lemosheh missinay — dinah kebattim uretzuot shetztzerikim lihyot mimmin hammuttar lepika, velo mimmin haasur. Abal bematlit shello shayyak bah issur — en lehaqpid bah:

Halaka lemosheh missinay sheyyikrok al happarasha sear behema o chayya hattehorim. Yesh omerim sheyyikrok hassear al gup happarasha, veachar-kak yikrok haqqelap lemala. Veyesh omerim shemmittechilla yikrok alehem haqqelap, veachar-kak hassear al gabbe haqqelap. Venohagin latzet yede shenehem, shekkorekin sear al happarasha veachar-kak korekin alayv qelap kasher, vechozerin vekorekin alayv sear. Venahagu sheyyihyeh sear zeh shel egel, kede sheyyizkor maaseh haegel velo yecheta. Veim lo matza shel egel — korek beshel para o beshel shor, verochetz hassear heteb battechilla ad sheyyihyeh naqi. Vechakme hazzohar hizhiru veameru sheyyihyeh qetzat sear zeh yotze chutz labbattim shel rosh pachot meorek seora. Yesh omerim shehassear hayyotze yihyeh mipparashat "qaddesh", veyesh omerim mipparashat "vehaya im shamoa", vetob sheyyetze mipparashat "vehaya im shamoa" batztzad happoneh leparashat "qaddesh":

Kol parasha tzerika lihyot zequpa meummad betok betah lekattechilla, kederek shemmaamidin seper tora bahekal. Veim netanah sham mushkebet — keshera. Vetzarik lizzaher shello lahapok happarashiyyot babbattim, ella yannichem sham beinyan sheshshita haelyona tihyeh lemala berosh habbattim veshita hattachtona lematta letzad peh habbattim. Ulekattechilla yesh lizzaher sherosh happarasha yihyeh munnach letzad yemin haqqore shehu omed neged hammeniach, sheim ba lepotchan uleqoran yihyu munnachin lepanayv kehilkatan, shehare matzinu shesseder hanachatan babbattim hen mesuddarim lepi yemin haqqore sheyyihyeh qore kasseder, mittechilla parashat "qaddesh" shel yemino veachar-kak parashat "vehaya" ushear happarashiyyot shel semolo, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman lad:

Im katab kol haarba parashiyyot biqlap echad — kesherot, apillu en revach benehem, ubilbad sheyyittenen bearbaa battim, kol achat mushkebet bebetah. Vetzarik sheyyitten chut o meshicha ben kol bayit lebayit, lehabdilah zeh mizzeh. Yesh omerim shello hitzriku habdala zo ella davqa keshekkol haarba parashiyyot niktabot al qelap echad, abal im hen ketubot al arbaa qelapim kehilkatan — en tzarik chut o meshicha kelal. Veyesh omerim sheapillu hen ketubot al arbaa qelapim — tzarik lehaabir chut o meshicha ben kol bayit lebayit. Veken nohagin lehaabir chut hattepira ben kol bayit lebayit lekattechilla, abal im lo heebir — kasher, shehaiqqar kassebara harishona:

Parashiyyot shel yad dinan keshel rosh likrikat sear uqelap, ulegolelan missopan litchillatan, ulehaknisan lebetan zequpot, ella shellekattechilla tzarik lekotban al qelap echad mittaam shennitbaer lemala. Veim ketaban al arbaa qelapim vehinnichan bearbaa battim kemo shel rosh — yatza. Vehu sheshshatach or al haarbaa battim sheyyihyu nirim kebayit echad, mippene shetztzarik sheyyihyeh ot achat mibbachutz kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veen tzarik lomar im ketaban al arbaa qelapim vehinnichan bebayit echad sheyyatza, veen tzarik ledabbeq haqqelapim yachad. Veap-al-pi-ken hamminhag ledabbeqan bedebeq. Venizharin littol debeq kasher, dehaynu mibbehema hattehora, sheyyihyeh mimmin hammuttar bepika:
Im tzippa habbattim bezahab, o beor sheeno kasher laasot mimmennu battim, kegon shel behema temea — hare ellu pesulim:

Halaka lemosheh missinay sheyyihyu hattepillin nitparin begide behema o chayya hattehorim (loqechim haggidin sheyyesh baaqeb behema o chayya shehen gidim lebanim, veim hem qashim — merakkekan baabanim ad sheyyehe asuy kepishtan, vetovin veshozerin otan). Veyesh mi sheomer sheqqabbala beyado min haggeonim shemmitzva litpor begide shor — lekattechilla. Vetob lachosh lidbarayv:

En lelek lebatte hannokrim liqnot mehem gidim, im yadua shemmiqtzatan notelin otan mibbehema temea, ap al pi sheharob notelin mibbehema tehora, lepi shekkevan shehu holek etzel nokri beshaa shehem qebuin bebattehen — en holekin bazeh achar harob, shekkol haqqabua kemechetza al mechetza. Abal im hannokri hebi lashshuq muttar liqnot mimmennu, shekkevan shepperesh mimmeqom qebiuto — anu omerim kol happoresh min harob hu poresh. Veim en yadua shemmiqtzatan notelin otan mibbehema temea — muttar liqnot mehem bekol inyan, sherob behemot hanneekalim hem tehorim, umeotan sheenan neekalin en notelin mehem gidim, shebbevadday en hannokri nocher behemto bishbil gideha. Vekol zeh begidim sheenan tevuyin, abal gidim tevuyin — asur liqnot mehem bekol inyan, shekkevan shehalaka lemosheh missinay hen — tzarik shettihyeh asiyyatan lishman, kemo shetztzarik laasot haretzuot shechorot lishman, mippene shehashcharatan hi halaka lemosheh missinay, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman lag. Uteviyyat haggidim — zo hi asiyyatan, vetzarik lihyot lishmah (kemo shechute hatztzitzit, teviyyatan — zo hi asiyyatan, vetzarik lihyot lishmah), venokrim lav bene lishmah hen:

Yesh mi sheomer shechutin hannaasin min haqqelap hen kegidim atzman, ukesherin litpor bahen seper tora utepillin. Veyesh lismok al debarayv bemaqom sheen gidim metzuyim litpor bechutin ellu ad sheyyizdammenu lahem gidim, shello lehitbattel mimmitzvat tepillin:

Qabbala beyad haggeonim litpor shettem esreh tepirot keneged shenem asar shebatim, shalosh tepirot bekol tzad. Vechut hattepira yihyeh sobeb mishte ruchot bekol tepira utepira. Veim pichet mishtem esreh tepirot, o hosip — lo pasal. Veen tzarik shettihyeh hattepira betok habbayit ella samuk labbayit. Umikkol maqom, tzarik sheyyihyeh or habbayit mitpashshet venikpal ben shene hakkepalim shel hattittora bimqom hattepira, kede shettihyeh hattepira gam baor hammitpashshet mehabbayit (shehu nechshab miggup habbayit), venimtza gup habbayit tapur battittora. Veim lav — pasul, shehare halaka lemosheh missinay shettepillin yihyu tepurin, vehabbattim hem hanniqraim tepillin velo hattittora, shemmippene zeh tzarik lerabbea gam gup habbattim, velo day beribbua hattittora, mippene sheameru: tepillin merubbaot halaka lemosheh missinay, vehabbattim hem hanniqraim tepillin, vehattittora niqret — tittora shel tepillin:

Yesh machamirin sheim nipsaq chut hattepira beemtza hattepira — yittelennu kullo mishsham veyachazor veyitpor mechadash bechut acher, shekkevan shennipsaq bishat hattepira — bevadday eno chazaq vesopo lippaseq, vekol haomed lippaseq — kepasuq hu, veeno kelum. Abal im hachut qatzar mittechillato velo nipsaq — yakol ligmor bechut acher, veen tzarik shettihyeh kol hattepira bechut echad:

Qesher shel tepillin — halaka lemosheh missinay, shelleachar shehiknis haretzua letok hammabarta — yaaseh qesher kemin dale"t beshel rosh ukemin yu"d beshel yad, lehashlim otiyyot shadda"y im hashshi"n shebbeshel rosh. Vetob lizzaher lehashlim hashshem kesidro, shemmittechilla yaaseh hashshi"n veachar-kak haqqesher shel rosh, veqesher shel yad achar-kak, keseder otiyyot hashshem. Vehaqqesher shel rosh — en tzarik sheyyihyeh nireh kemin dale"t ella mitztzad chutz, velo mitztzad penim shekkelappe harosh, veyesh nohagin laasoto beinyan sheyyihyeh nireh kemin dale"t mishshene tzedadin:

Venohagin lehaabir or al habbayit shel yad lerochab hazzeroa, lepi shehattepillin shel yad hem gebohim uqetzarim, umesimin otan tachat habbegadim umitqalqelin tachat habbegadim, lekak nahagu lehaabir alehen retzua zo lechazzeqan. Ubemiqtzat meqomot en nohagin lehaabirah:
